entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Nails, claws, talons; Veins, spots, dirt, grime
entries.zh: 指甲、爪子、利爪；血管、斑点、泥土、污垢。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Bony, skeletal, shovel-like, long-fingered; Wrinkled, swollen, lumpy; Black, sharp, dirty
entries.zh: 骨感、骷髅般、铲子般、长手指；起皱、肿胀、疙疙瘩瘩；黑、尖、脏。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Covered, blackened, encrusted; Chipped, burnt, twisted; Felt, shook, held; Drummed, grabbed, grasped, lunged
entries.zh: 覆盖、变黑、结满；磕缺、烧伤、扭曲；摸起来、握手、伸出；敲击、抓住、攥取、猛扑。

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 布满皱纹的双手

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 烧伤扭曲成爪形的手

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 手指细长、骨节突出的手

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 铲子般的大手

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 像爪子一样的指甲

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 乌黑的利爪

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 危险的武器

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 肿胀凸起的血管

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Veins like rivers on a map
entries.zh: 血管像地图上的河流

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 沾满泥土污垢，肮脏不堪

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 磨得尖尖的

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 磕缺且结满污垢

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Felt as cold as a skeleton
entries.zh: 摸起来冰冷得像骷髅

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 和他握手

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 伸出一只骨瘦嶙峋的手

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Backed away from the claw-like hand
entries.zh: 从那爪子般的手前退开

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 一把抓住她的手腕

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Grasped at the air in front of him
entries.zh: 在面前的空气中抓挠

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 向他猛扑过去

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 不耐烦地用手指敲桌子

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His nails were chipped and encrusted with dirt.
entries.zh: 他的指甲残缺不齐，结满污垢。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Two enormous shovel-like hands lunged at him.
entries.zh: 两只铲子般的大手朝他猛扑过来。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She drummed her long, bony fingers on the table impatiently.
entries.zh: 她用细长的骨感手指不耐烦地敲着桌子。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His hand was a burnt, twisted claw, with blackened talons for nails.
entries.zh: 他的手烧伤后扭曲得像爪子，发黑的指甲就像利爪。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her old hands were swollen and covered in lumpy blue veins like rivers on a map.
entries.zh: 她苍老的双手肿胀，凸起的青色血管像地图上的河流。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He backed away from the claw-like hand that was grasping at the air in front of him.
entries.zh: 他往后退，躲开那只在面前空气里抓挠的爪子般的手。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her nails were like claws, sharpened to points and dangerous weapons.
entries.zh: 她的指甲像爪子，磨得尖尖的，成了危险的武器。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She held out a bony hand, which felt as cold as a skeleton when Robert shook it.
entries.zh: 她伸出一只骨感的手，罗伯特握上去时觉得冷得像握着骷髅。
